metadata.description: Internal marketplace for GNOX governance and compliance tooling plugins.

plugins.name: gnox-risk-management
plugins.description: Wizard-driven bootstrap and lifecycle management of controlled risk-management documentation sets (risk assessment, mitigation, reporting, implementation plans) for IT/IP risk scenarios — AI-tooling payload audit by default, print/physical-document egress included. Profile × scenario × stage modular; generic → proposed → approved → implemented lifecycle with incorporation of approved finals; pinned reference corpus fixing regulatory/SOP language against drift.

plugins.name: stalker
plugins.description: stalcaire: the watcher. Boot-challenge provenance verification, reliquary storage layer (/mnt/doom), ed25519 lifecycle ledger, and provable unmaking (mount-doom skill). Castle Aaargh was the filming name; Castle Stalker is the real one.
